result.summary: Screenshot of the Zephyr AI code editor on a dark theme, split into a left editor/launcher area and a right AI chat panel. The right panel has an Agent tab bar at top, a centered 'Ask about this code' prompt with three action cards, and a composer box at the bottom with a control row. The send button is visible and green; the composer's placeholder text appears truncated.
